how to be the better person,
always

1. don't repeat what was told to you in confidence

even when it would make a great story.

2. give credit out loud

'that was her idea.'
it costs nothing and people never forget it.

3. let people be wrong sometimes

not every mistake needs your correction.

4. apologize without 'but'

'i'm sorry' is a full sentence.

5. keep learning, quietly

before, i judged what i didn't understand.
now i learn one new thing every morning. and i judge a lot less.
